  • Neben dem operativen Einkauf gestaltest Du Prozesse und Strukturen aktiv mit und bringst Deine Ideen bei der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des Einkaufs ein.

  • Auch die laufende ERP-Umstellung sowie die Optimierung der Einkaufsabläufe begleitest Du aktiv.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine kaufmännische bzw. technische Ausbildung – idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Einkauf.

  • Mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung und Fachkompetenz im Bereich Anlagenbau zeichnen Dich aus.

  • Du besitzt ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsvermögen und trittst stets sicher auf.

  • Gutes technisches Verständnis ist für Dich ebenfalls selbstverständlich.

  • Deine Englischkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher.

  • Eine strukturierte, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise rundet Dein Profil ab.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Du erhältst eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Teamleiterfunktion und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Dich erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, offener Du-Kultur und einem jungen Geschäftsführer-Duo.

  • Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch Dein Team und Deinen Vorgänger sorgt für einen gelungenen Einstieg.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit, nach der Einarbeitung einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten, unterstützen eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

  • Neben 30 Urlaubstagen profitierst Du von einer attraktiven Vergütung, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksamen Leistungen.

  • Hansefit, BusinessBike und eine monatliche Tankkarte runden das Angebot ab.

  • Ab 2027 kommt zudem eine Beteiligung an dem Gewinn des Unternehmens hinzu.

Großartig! Bewirb Dich am besten direkt online über das Kontaktformular. Alternativ kannst Du uns Deine Bewerbung per Mail an senden. Wir übernehmen im Auftrag unseres Kunden die Vorauswahl bei dieser Position.

data.title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
data.description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

  • Take services end to end: design, ship, and run them in production, across both cloud and on-prem

  • Solve the performance and scaling problems that come with multi-tenant systems and large datasets

  • Help shape architecture and technical direction, where your input genuinely moves things in a team this small


  • 5+ years writing production-grade Go

  • Strong grasp of idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, and profiling with pprof, plus a real understanding of escape analysis, allocation behavior, and what the GC is actually doing

  • Solid experience building and maintaining APIs using gRPC, including Protobuf versioning, streaming, and API lifecycle best practices (bonus: you know Google AIPs)

  • Proven experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), performance tuning, and schema design

  • Comfortable in cloud-native environments, applying caching, queuing, and observability best practices

  • Professional working proficiency in English, enough to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to peers and stakeholders

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

What you can expect from us:

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a digital moving company.

Our team does not move tables, filing cabinets or chairs. Natuvion transports business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. Typical Natuvion "relocation services" include data migration, data transformation, data integration, data privacy, data security, and data quality.

Our >400 consultants and developers in Germany, Austria, Slovakia, the USA and Australia have extensive know-how in (SAP)® projects and a profound understanding of processes across industry boundaries. With a lot of experience, commitment and commitment, they support our customers with advice, services and their own software technology. In this way, we enable companies to always use their data and processes on the most modern and innovative platforms.

Are you interested? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!
Feel free to send us your CV, we do not need a cover letter.

data.description:
We are a small engineering team inside Natuvion that finds and builds the next high-value additions to Natuvion's

product portfolio. We build DCS Compose, a modern language for enterprise data transformations with deep integration

into the Natuvion Cloud.

Our work has three main aspects

  • Understanding the domain. We make Natuvion's transformation knowledge searchable, structured, and available to AI agents.   • User focused development. We understand our users and develop tools and applications for them. Our mission is to help our users excel at their work by providing them with the technical means to do so.

  • Technical ownership. We develop solutions with deep integration into Natuvion's cloud landscape. We develop the backend and frontend functionality keeping in mind performance, adaptability and correctness.

We build on top of the Natuvion Cloud, using its APIs and shared components as our foundation.

The cloud team scales the platform; we focus on what to build on it.

The team has strong technical and scientific backgrounds. We care about quality even in prototypes: Disciplined engineering, not vibe-coding.

We're part of Natuvion (~500 employees, SAP Gold Partner). That means access to enterprise customers, real

transformation projects, and corporate backing, with the autonomy of a small team.

  • Real problems, not toy projects. Enterprise data transformations involve millions of records, complex business rules, and tight timelines. The prototypes you build here solve real problems for real customers.

data.title: Working Student IT Operations (m/f/d)
data.description:
Hi!

We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. With over 5 million euros raised in donations, we cannot wait to increase our positive impact with you on our team, one cup of coffee at a time.

Your role

  • Support the IT setup across our cafés, office, and warehouse, from POS systems and printers to tablets, routers, and Raspberry Pis.
  • Keep our UniFi networks and internet connections running and help troubleshoot issues remotely or on-site.
  • Maintain and provision devices, keep our hardware inventory clean, and support onboarding and offboarding.
  • Document setups, fixes, and processes in Notion so knowledge stays accessible.
  • Support practical GDPR and information security topics, including TOMs, deletion concepts, access management, and security documentation.
  • Report to our CTO and be part of our Tech Team.

Your profile
  • You’re currently enrolled at university, ideally in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field.
  • You have a basic understanding of networks and Linux and enjoy learning new technical topics.
  • You work independently, stay organized, and appreciate good documentation.
  • You have experience with UniFi, GDPR or ISO 27001 is a plus, not a must.
  • You’re happy to travel between our Berlin locations when needed. Being based in Berlin and working mainly onsite is non-negotiable for this role.
  • You are available 20 hours a week, 3 days a week. Based on your availability, you can choose the days you work (Monday to Saturday).
  • You’re fluent in English; German is a plus.

And this is what you will get from us
  • Flexible working hours. Our core working hours are from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM, but of course we understand that Working Students have different needs.
  • Discounts on our coffee and accessories, as well as access to online voucher platforms like Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.
  • Access to platforms for mental and physical health, such as nilohealth, and the possibility to have access to Urban Sports Club M membership after 1 year with us.  
  • The best coffee in the office and quarterly coffee vouchers to enjoy your favorite drink at home with your loved ones.
  • Regular All-Hands meetings, coffee training, and interdisciplinary team events.

What we believe in

We are a purpose-driven organization. For us, growth means increasing our social impact in coffee cooperatives around the world and opening a new world of coffee to our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and compassion to build strong and innovative teams. We cultivate a humble and playful mindset to create an endless learning experience for our team.

No matter your ethnicity, skin color, descent, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity – if the job description fits you, we can’t wait to meet you.

data.title: Senior Brand Partnerships & Licensing Manager (All Genders)
data.description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. We are 120 people strong, with 170+ SKUs and aggressive growth across D2C, retail, Amazon, and new European markets.

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

Are you a senior brand partnerships and licensing professional who closes deals, owns projects end-to-end, and has the network to make things happen from day one? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Partner Identification & Pipeline Management: You proactively source, evaluate, and pitch licensing and co-branding opportunities across entertainment IPs, cultural icons, celebrities, and lifestyle brands. You run an active pipeline of 5-10 live opportunities at any given time and know which ones are worth pursuing for our brand and commercial goals.

  • Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line.

  • End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. You keep cross-functional teams across brand, product, design, legal, sales, retail, and D2C moving in the same direction and on time.

  • Business Case & Performance Ownership: You build and own the business case for every collaboration: budget, margin, revenue forecast, and post-launch review. You track revenue contribution, retail sell-through, D2C performance, and brand awareness lift per edition, and use it to make the next one better.

  • Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency. You have taken 3+ limited editions or co-branded drops from concept to launch and can point to the results. You are a strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset and a proven execution track record.

  • You have negotiated and signed LOIs, licensing agreements, and talent contracts with full commercial responsibility. You come with a network of IP holders, agencies, talent managers, and entertainment companies that opens doors from day one.

  • You are comfortable juggling multiple complex workstreams at once, aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority, and holding a timeline without micromanaging. You have owned 6-7 figure budgets and built business cases from zero.

  • You communicate with confidence in both German and English. Native-level German and full fluency in English are required.

  • You take responsibility for your projects and your numbers, make clear decisions even when the path is not, and thrive where speed and ownership matter.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience working directly with entertainment studios, IP holders, or major talent agencies.
  • Background in FMCG, food & beverage, or better-for-you consumer brands.
  • Existing relationships in the DACH retail landscape with sell-in experience for limited editions.
  • Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time.
  • Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
For this role, you can choose whether to work from our offices in Hamburg or Berlin, or fully remotely from anywhere in Germany. If this sounds like a good fit, we would love to get to know you!


Disclaimer

ahead GmbH is an equal opportunity workplace and is devoted to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

data.description:
Über Valiantys 
 
Schließe dich Valiantys an und werde Teil von etwas Außergewöhnlichem!
Bei Valiantys sind wir kein typischer Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner – wir sind die treibende Kraft hinter beeindruckenden, bahnbrechenden Lösungen, die mit größter Sorgfalt für die Atlassian-Produktpalette entwickelt werden.
Wir sind Pioniere in der Bereitstellung modernster Tools für Teamzusammenarbeit und Produktivität. Denk an uns als das Raketentreibmittel, das Unternehmen antreibt und sie zu unvergleichlichem Erfolg und höchster Effizienz führt!
Stell dir nun vor, du begibst dich auf eine spannende Reise mit Valiantys und Atlassian – eine Reise, auf der Innovation keine Grenzen kennt und dein Beitrag im Mittelpunkt steht.
 

Als Principal Transformation Consultant übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle beim Aufbau wichtiger Kundenbeziehungen, bei der Umsetzung komplexer Transformationsprogramme und beim Ausbau unseres Geschäfts.

Du arbeitest eng mit Senior Executives zusammen, um Transformationsstrategien zu definieren und umzusetzen. Dazu gehören Cloud-Migrationen, technologische Modernisierung und unternehmensweite digitale Initiativen.

Diese Rolle verbindet strategisches Consulting, Business Development und technologische Führung. Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Aufgabe ist consultative selling. Du identifizierst geschäftliche Herausforderungen, entwickelst überzeugende Value Propositions und wandelst Opportunities in erfolgreiche Kundenprojekte um.

Mit deinem Verständnis für Enterprise Software Delivery, den Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) und moderne Engineering Practices hilfst du unseren Kunden, ihre Transformation zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die Präsenz von Valiantys in strategischen Accounts auszubauen.

Du berichtest an den Transformation Consulting Director.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

Kundenpartnerschaft & Projektdelivery

  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Executive Stakeholdern auf, darunter Director, VP und C-Level.
  • Du verstehst die Geschäftsziele, Technologielandschaft und Transformationsprioritäten unserer Kunden.
  • Du führst und unterstützt Consulting-Teams bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer, mehrstufiger Transformationsprogramme.
  • Du erzielst messbare Geschäftsergebnisse in Bereichen wie Cloud-Migration, Plattformmodernisierung und Enterprise Toolchain Transformation.

Technologie & Transformation

  • Du berätst Kunden dabei, ihre Software Delivery zu verbessern. Dabei nutzt du dein starkes Verständnis des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Developer Experience (DevEx), agiler Delivery, DevOps und moderner Engineering Practices.
  • Du begleitest Kunden bei Migration Readiness Assessments, Architekturentscheidungen und der Planung von Cloud-Transitionen.
  • Du bleibst auf dem neuesten Stand zu Atlassian-Innovationen, cloud-nativen Technologien, AI-Trends und neuen Software Engineering Practices.
  • Du übersetzt komplexe technische Themen in klare Business-Empfehlungen für Executive Audiences.
  • Du förderst die praktische Einführung von AI, indem du neue AI-Fähigkeiten, Enterprise Use Cases und deren Auswirkungen auf Software Delivery und Business Transformation verstehst.

Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Du arbeitest während des gesamten Sales Lifecycles eng mit den Sales-Teams zusammen, von der Qualifizierung und Executive Discovery bis hin zu Proposal, Verhandlung und Deal Closure.
  • Du leitest consultative Discovery Sessions, um geschäftliche Herausforderungen aufzudecken und Transformationsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
  • Du entwickelst überzeugende Statements of Work, Business Cases und Executive Proposals mit Fokus auf messbare Geschäftsergebnisse.
  • Du definierst und setzt Account Growth Strategies um, durch Upselling, Cross-Selling und strategische Account-Entwicklung.
  • Du wendest strukturierte Qualifizierungsmethoden wie MEDDPICC an, um Win Rates zu maximieren.
  • Du bringst kommerzielle und technische Expertise in Solution Scoping, Pricing und Risk Management ein.

Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Du entwickelst Transformations-Roadmaps, die auf die Geschäftsziele der Kunden abgestimmt sind.
  • Du arbeitest mit internen Practices zusammen, darunter AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale und Developer Experience.
  • Du übersetzt geschäftliche und technische Anforderungen in überzeugende Value Propositions.
  • Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Frameworks, Methoden und Accelerators, die das Consulting-Angebot von Valiantys stärken.

Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Du agierst als Mentor und Sparringspartner für Consultants auf allen Ebenen und trägst zu Wissensaufbau, Kompetenzentwicklung und Team Performance bei.
  • Du teilst Marktinformationen, Kunden-Insights und Delivery Learnings intern, um Offering Development und Delivery Practices weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Professionalität und Kundenorientierung im UKI Consulting-Team.

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Consulting, in Professional Services oder in Enterprise Transformation.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung von Enterprise Cloud Migration oder Technology Modernisation Programmes.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Enterprise Sales, consultative selling und Business Development, mit der Fähigkeit, Opportunities zu identifizieren, Business Cases zu erstellen und Advisory Engagements in Umsatz umzuwandeln.
  • Starkes Verständnis von Enterprise Technology Environments, einschließlich Cloud-Plattformen wie Atlassian Cloud und AWS, DevOps Toolchains sowie ITSM- und PPPM-Disziplinen.
  • Starke Kenntnisse des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), agiler Methoden, CI/CD, Developer Experience und moderner Software Engineering Practices.
  • Verständnis für Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI und AI-assisted Software Development, sowie die Fähigkeit, deren Business Value und praktische Enterprise-Anwendungen zu erklären.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Management und Ausbau strategischer Kundenaccounts.
  • Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Moderations-, Präsentations- und Workshop-Fähigkeiten.
  • Eine proaktive und anpassungsfähige Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, strategisches Denken und hands-on Execution zu verbinden.

Nice to Have

  • MEDDPICC oder eine vergleichbare Sales Qualification Methodology.
  • Erfahrung mit Agile at Scale, zum Beispiel SAFe, LeSS oder vergleichbare Frameworks.
  • Erfahrung mit Managed Services oder langfristigen Customer Success Engagements.

  • Erfahrung darin, Organisationen bei der Definition oder Einführung von AI-Strategien zu unterstützen, basierend auf messbaren Kundenergebnissen und Business Use Cases.

Standort & Arbeitsmodell

Diese Position ist in Deutschland angesiedelt.
Wir sind offen für Remote Work innerhalb Deutschlands, mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kundenstandorten.
Gelegentliche Reisen innerhalb der EMEA-Region können ebenfalls erforderlich sein.

Gemeinsam mit Branchenexpertinnen und Branchenexperten arbeitest du in einem kollaborativen und unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du hast die Möglichkeit, echten Einfluss zu nehmen und gleichzeitig deine eigene Expertise kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Warum Valiantys?
 
Unsere Teammitglieder sind unser größtes Kapital, und wir setzen alles daran, dass Valiantys nicht nur ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist, sondern auch eine Plattform für persönliches Wachstum.
Ownership. Du hast maßgeblichen Einfluss auf die Strategie und übernimmst Verantwortung für deinen Aufgabenbereich.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

The Boarding domain builds and maintains the platform that onboards merchants onto PPRO's network of the products and services that get our customers live, fast, compliant, and reliable. At the center of it all is the merchant: every system we build, every API we ship, connects internal teams and external clients around getting merchants onboarded smoothly. As a Software Engineer, you own live, public-facing APIs built to handle real scale, take on well-defined but moderately complex problems, work largely independently within the team, and own your piece of the boarding pipeline end-to-end.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build, test, and operate services within the Boarding platform, following the "you build it, you run it" mindset

  • Work largely independently on team-scoped tasks, seeking guidance from senior teammates and your manager on ambiguous or cross-team topics

  • Adapt quickly when priorities shift, re-plan your own work, communicate impact, and keep delivery moving without needing to be told twice

data.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
data.description:
About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next.

  • You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful.

  • You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges.

  • You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases.

  • You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics.

  • Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development.

  • You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback.

  • Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions.


What you need to succeed

  • You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering.

  • You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations.

  • You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.

  • You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.

  • You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.

  • You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.

  • You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.

  • Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus.

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. You'll have the opportunity to actively influence technology decisions, elevate our IT security to the next level, and expand our infrastructure as a key enabler of the company's continued growth.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture & Networking: You design, build, and scale our cloud infrastructure. This includes managing core networking components such as VPCs, routing, DNS, and load balancing, while ensuring secure, highly available connectivity across our locations.

  • Core Application Infrastructure: You take ownership of the infrastructure behind our business-critical applications, including deployment, hosting optimization, and performance tuning. Your primary focus will be a complex Java application and a large-scale PHP platform.

  • Monitoring & Observability: You ensure end-to-end visibility across our systems by designing, implementing, and continuously enhancing our monitoring and observability stack (e.g., Grafana). You also establish effective alerting to enable proactive issue detection and resolution.

At the same time, you keep our long-term goal of maintaining a cloud-agnostic architecture in mind.

  • Security & Best Practices: You evaluate and implement modern cloud-native solutions to enhance our secrets management and establish industry best practices for infrastructure security across our engineering processes.

  • Process Reliability & CI/CD: You design, build, and maintain highly automated CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, efficient deployments. You also implement automated recovery mechanisms that ensure interrupted processes can resume seamlessly.


What you need to succeed

You have a structured, methodical, and self-driven way of working, backed by several years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure administration, for example as a Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, or DevOps Engineer.

With your collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and approachable personality, you confidently work across teams and stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on infrastructure-related topics. You take a holistic approach to problem-solving while maintaining a strong focus on compliance requirements and the highest standards of data security.

Your (technical) profile

  • Linux Administration: Proven hands-on experience administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting Linux-based systems.

  • Networking Expertise: Strong understanding of modern networking architectures and protocols, including routing, firewalls, VPNs, and cloud networking.

  • PHP & Java Ecosystems: Demonstrated experience operating and optimizing large-scale PHP and Java applications in production, as well as building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. An architectural understanding of the specific requirements of both ecosystems, JVMs and application servers for Java, as well as web servers and PHP-FPM for PHP, is a strong advantage.

data.title: New Business Account Executive (DACH market)
data.description:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany.
We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers.
If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Originate Institutional Pipeline: Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates.
  • Leverage Channel Partnerships: Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups.
  • Navigate Complex Sales Cycles: Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing.
  • Position Vivid as a Yield Partner: Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder.
  • Shape the German Playbook: Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management).
  • Deep local knowledge: You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships.
  • An established network: You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents.
  • Technical fluency: You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English and German is required. 


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

data.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Overview

Relay is a parcel delivery network. Every night, parcels from online retailers arrive at our sort centres, are sorted into delivery routes, and go out the next day with couriers. Two things have to go right for that to work.

Routing is the planning side: software that decides, before parcels have even arrived, which ones to expect, how to group them into routes, and how to make those routes efficient for couriers to drive. Sortation is the physical side: warehouse teams and sorting robots turning a building full of parcels into neatly separated routes, thousands of times a night.

The two are tightly coupled. If the plan expects a parcel that never arrives, a courier's route has a hole in it. If the warehouse sorts a parcel the plan didn't expect, it has nowhere to go. This role owns the analytics across both: spotting when either side is off, working out why, and building the case for what to change.

Your work splits between a daily operational rhythm (is the network healthy this morning, and if not, why) and deeper investigations (what is driving cost, where is the plan falling short of what's possible, what should we change). Your analysis won't sit in a dashboard waiting to be discovered - it will change which parcels get planned for, how warehouse shifts are scheduled, and where the operation focuses its improvement efforts.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into teams across the business. You will sit with the Routing & Sortation teams but report into the central data team, working daily with software engineers, warehouse operations, commercial, and finance.

What You'll Do

Routing

  • Monitor the health of each night's route plans: how many parcels each route carries (planned vs what actually happened), how far couriers travel before their first delivery, and the routes no courier should ever be handed - a single parcel stranded miles from every other stop, or one route torn between two towns - and diagnose the cause when any of it moves

  • Track how well we predict which parcels will arrive each night: when expected parcels don't show up, or unexpected ones do, work out whether the cause was the retailer's data, a warehouse error, or timing, and improve the prediction rules client by client

  • Act on what you find: flag issues to warehouse managers and retailer-facing teams, and correct the plan when a retailer's parcels arrive outside the normal flow

  • Monitor the route optimisation engine itself and flag regressions when the software or its inputs change

  • Quantify how route design affects courier productivity: deliveries per hour, stops per route, distance between drops - and how far our actual routes sit from the best theoretically possible

  • Build the reporting that diagnoses the middle leg of the network: the van journeys that move sorted parcels from sort centres out to local pick-up points where couriers collect them

  • Partner with the engineers who build the routing systems to test and validate changes

Sortation

  • Investigate cost per parcel: where are we spending too much, where are savings available, and what's driving the variance

  • Track warehouse operative performance: throughput, accuracy, shift utilisation, and the balance between permanent and agency labour

  • Monitor sorting robot efficiency and capacity: what volumes can they sustain, where are the bottlenecks, how do they compare to manual sorting

  • Build models to predict how many operatives each shift needs, and help automate workforce planning around the best performers

  • Compare the parcel volumes retailers actually send us against what they told us to expect, and find where the gaps come from

  • Define KPIs and build dashboards that make routing and sortation performance transparent to operations and leadership

  • Work with commercial teams to set volume limits and delivery timings that balance growth with operational stability

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

  • You want to understand how an operation actually works, not just analyse it from a distance

  • You're comfortable being the person operations and engineering ping first when something looks off in the morning, and you enjoy the detective work of finding out why

  • You're excited by cost and efficiency problems - finding where money or time is leaking and building the case for how to fix it

  • You can navigate messy operational data and turn it into metrics people trust

  • You know how to take a large amount of complex data and visualise it in a way people can actually digest - your dashboards tell someone what to look at and why, rather than presenting every number you have

  • You're comfortable working with operations teams and embedding your analysis into their daily workflows

  • You're fluent in SQL and experienced with BI tools, with strong problem-solving instincts

  • You have at least 3 years experience, ideally with some exposure to logistics or another physical operation

  • You care about impact, not just insight - you measure success by whether the operation runs better

  • You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can explain what the data shows and where the limitations are

Fast and Focused Hiring Process

  1. Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins | Online

  2. Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins

  3. SQL Live Coding - 60mins

  4. Case Study - 60mins

  5. Relay Operating Principles & Impact- 60mins

  6. Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

data.title: Privacy & Product Counsel
data.description:
Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

We're looking for a Privacy & Product Counsel who can build Hilbert's privacy program from the inside of the product - not bolt one on after the fact - who is fluent across US, UK, and European privacy law, and who can move at the speed our engineering and GTM teams already move at, with the ownership and urgency of a startup culture.

You'll be the first dedicated privacy hire, embedded with product and engineering as we design agentic systems that touch consumer data across dozens of enterprise environments and the person our biggest customers' legal and security teams call when they want to understand how our AI actually handles their data - wherever they're based. You'll also be the generalist backstop for whatever legal question lands on the desk that week.

THE ROLE

You'll work directly with the founding team and across product, engineering, and GTM to build and run Hilbert's privacy program end-to-end - while also owning the product and commercial legal work that comes with selling an agentic AI platform into enterprise accounts.

The environment is high-autonomy and high-ambiguity - new data types, new customer environments, and new AI capabilities show up faster than settled law does.

What you'll do:

Privacy Program

  • Design, build, and run Hilbert's privacy program - policies, data mapping, retention, and vendor/subprocessor management - from the ground up, covering both US and UK/EU entities and data flows

  • Advise product and engineering on privacy-by-design for agentic workflows: what data an agent can access, retain, infer, or act on, and how that's documented and defensible under whichever regime applies

  • Own compliance posture across CCPA/CPRA and the US state privacy patchwork, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, and EU GDPR, and track how state, federal, UK, and EU AI-specific rules are developing

  • Build and maintain data processing agreements, international data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, UK IDTA/Addendum), and subprocessor frameworks that scale across enterprise customers without a bespoke redline every time

Product & Commercial Counsel

  • Review and negotiate enterprise customer contracts, DPAs, and security addenda across US and UK/EU counterparties, working closely with sales to keep deals moving without compromising the company's data commitments

  • Advise product on how new agentic features get built, marketed, and disclosed — including where an AI decision needs a human-in-the-loop checkpoint for legal or trust reasons

  • Partner with security on incident response, breach notification obligations, and customer-facing security representations across jurisdictions

  • Be the primary point of contact for enterprise customers' legal, security, and procurement teams when they ask how Hilbert's AI handles their data

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

The right person in this role is quick to turn regulatory nuance into a product decision and show up with both engineers and enterprise counterparts.

The profile:

  • You have 6–7 years of PQE in privacy and product/commercial counsel, ideally split between in-house work at a data-intensive or AI company and enterprise contract negotiation.

  • You're genuinely fluent across US, UK, and EU privacy law — CCPA/CPRA and the state patchwork, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, and EU GDPR.

  • You think like a product person, not just a lawyer. You'd rather sit in a design review and shape a data flow before it's built than redline it after.

  • You've negotiated enterprise DPAs, security addenda, and cross-border transfer mechanisms directly.

  • You're a genuine generalist, not just a specialist who's willing to help out.

  • You communicate with clarity and conviction. You can explain a data-retention tradeoff to a founder, hold your ground with an enterprise customer's outside counsel, and walk an engineer through why a feature needs a consent gate — all in the same day.

  • You take ownership. There's no one to hand this to. If the privacy program has a gap, you close it. If a deal is stuck on a legal term, you find the path through.

  • You move at startup speed. Deals close fast, product ships fast, and you're available and responsive without needing a legal-ops process to get there.

Location

San Francisco or London, hybrid, with occasional travel for customer engagements and to work with the other office.

The Hiring Journey

Short form → Intro call → Working session with product & engineering → Team conversations → Offer

Fast, human, no bureaucracy.

data.title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
data.description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

•      Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

•      Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

•      Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

•      Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

•      Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

•      Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

•      Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

•      Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

•      Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

•      Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

•      Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

•      Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

•      Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

•      Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

•      Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

•      Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

•      Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers

•      Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

•      Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

•      Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets


Essential

•      Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

•      MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

•      Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

•      API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

•      Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

•      Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

•      Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

•      UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

•      Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

•      Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

•      UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment

•      Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

•      Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

•      Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition

•      Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)

•      Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration

•      Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

•      Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts

•      Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

•      Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

•      Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware

•      AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Engagement  Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.

Clearance  SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.

Residency  UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.

Working model  Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.

Environment  Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.

Team shape  Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.

Timing  These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

data.title: Principal Technical SEO Specialist
data.description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role
Legend is hiring a Principal Technical SEO, reporting directly to our Chief Gaming Officer.
 
This is a rare opportunity to take portfolio-wide responsibility for the technical SEO performance of some of the largest and most commercially important domains in iGaming. Working alongside our existing Principal Technical SEO, you will co-own technical SEO across our Gaming portfolio, while also supporting our Sports portfolio.
 
You will identify the technical opportunities and risks that matter most, turn them into clear priorities, and work closely with Product and Engineering to deliver measurable organic and commercial impact. This is a deeply hands-on role where you will solve complex challenges across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, internationalisation, migrations and performance, while setting standards that scale across our portfolio.
 
You will also play a key role in advancing how we use AI and automation across SEO. You will build tools, monitoring, diagnostics and automated workflows yourself, using technology to improve the speed and quality of decision-making and helping our wider SEO teams adopt these capabilities.
 
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and visibility. You will lead through expertise rather than formal authority, working alongside senior specialists and leaders across SEO, Product, Engineering and Analytics to shape decisions across the organisation.
 
In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact:
  • Co-own our portfolio-wide technical SEO strategy, roadmap and standards, identifying and prioritising the opportunities and risks with the greatest potential organic and commercial impact.
  • Lead complex technical investigations across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, international SEO, migrations, structured data and web performance.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on architecture, major releases, migrations and experimentation, translating technical SEO insights into clear priorities and scalable solutions.
  • Build automated monitoring, diagnostics and early-warning systems that identify material technical issues before they become significant commercial problems.
  • Develop internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that improve analysis, quality assurance, prioritisation and execution across technical SEO and the wider SEO organisation.
  • Create reusable technical patterns, guardrails and frameworks across our portfolio, raising technical capability through coaching, documentation and shared tooling.

    • What You'll Bring:
  • Repeated technical SEO impact at scale - a strong track record of personally leading complex technical SEO initiatives across large websites or multi-domain portfolios, with clear evidence of measurable organic or commercial outcomes.
  • Exceptional technical SEO depth and judgement - expert knowledge across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, canonicalisation, international SEO, migrations, structured data, JavaScript SEO, log-file analysis and web performance, with the judgement to separate material opportunities from technical hygiene.
  • Hands-on coding, AI and automation capability - comfortable writing code and independently building tools, diagnostics, monitoring or automated workflows using APIs and large datasets, with examples of solutions that have been deployed and adopted by others.
  • Commercial and strategic thinking - able to translate complex technical findings into priorities based on expected value, risk, effort, confidence and opportunity cost, connecting technical decisions to organic and commercial outcomes.
  • Principal-level influence - experienced in influencing Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders without direct authority, challenging constructively and communicating complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A builder's mindset - intellectually curious, technically self-sufficient and comfortable remaining deeply hands-on while creating systems, standards and capabilities that increase the impact of teams beyond your own individual contribution.

    • The Interview Process:
    1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom.
    2nd: Interview with our Chief Gaming Officer - 60 minutes via Zoom.
    3rd: Technical SEO interview with senior members of our SEO team - 60 minutes via Zoom.
    4th: Case presentation and Principal peer interview - 90 minutes via Zoom, including a technical SEO assessment prepared ahead of the interview.

  • Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.

  • Long term incentive plan so we can all share in the growth and success of Legend.
  • Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!

That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences.
